knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson states that the WorkSafe Victoria alert does not state the cause of the guardrail failure. Any cause given by a learner is not confirmed.

practicalCriteria: Assessor shows a safety alert and the candidate separates what it states from what it does not state
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate. Completing the add-on grants no licence.
evidenceRequired: Assessor note on any licence or authority claim made by the candidate
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate names a cause of a failure that the source does not state
